display: 17 significant digits CSV; dynamic reader anchors; probabilities declared, not fitted
exclusions: Tonmick mechanism classification from response rates
adopting single fill as an adequate inferential procedure
changing any previous target, source data, random tape or reference answer
failures: changed college or frame group join
invalid response or binary group flags
malformed teaching roster, X support, law probabilities or fixed contract
fill_experiment: all 36 equal-probability subsets retaining two per X group. Replace four missing Y by retained grand mean. Filled mean equals retained mean, but naive iid variance shrinks by 3/14. Enumerate actual mask variance for finite-roster mean; do not confuse it with iid or conditional missing-value uncertainty.
group_standardization: candidate plug-in under a superpopulation conditional-mean transport model E(Y|group,C=1)=E(Y|group), with positive completion probability in each group; it is not an exact finite-roster equality or identification of its realized missing answers; finite prediction/model uncertainty remains uncomputed
mcar_experiment: all 70 uniform subsets retaining four of eight; report mean distribution only
nonidentification: two binary Y in {1,5}, R joint probability laws, constant X. Same observed law P(R=1,Y=1)=P(R=1,Y=5)=.25 and P(R=0)=.5. A is MCAR, B is MNAR. Full means differ. These are distributions, not two realized rosters or Tonmick truth.
ordinary_scope: response and complete-score descriptions by observed frame groups; candidate group-standardized complete mean and itemwise grand-mean fill are working calculations, not identified full-roster answers
pseudo_iid_variance: sample variance of filled person scores divided by 1600; deliberately invalid for fixed finite-roster missing-answer uncertainty; no CI or coverage claim
single_fill: retain every known raw cell; reverse st4 before computing item-specific keyed observed mean; replace only absent keyed cells by that mean; average five per person and 1600 people; fractional expected-value fills are not realized Likert answers
target: equal-person full measured baseline stress score mean over 1600 invitees, all five items with st4 reversed
teaching_population: eight explicitly hypothetical fixed people; X fully observed, Y in 1..5; no connection to hidden Tonmick scores
x_experiment: all 16 equal-probability subsets retaining three X=0 and one X=1; selection depends only on fully observed X. Compare retained mean, population-share standardized mean, saturated binary-X slope
